purpose: Versioned allow-list of production safety intents; it intentionally contains no split phrase, audio, voice, or rate realization.

allowed_intents.meaning: Clear people from a hazardous work area.
Disconnect or isolate an energy source.
Apply or lock a mechanical brake.
Close, lock, or block unsafe access.
Hold or suspend a load-related operation.
Report an alphanumeric production cue state.
Report an alphanumeric component or position state.
Report a numeric or technical signal fault.
Describe a medium or long pre-operation safety control.
